import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_55/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_55/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on 'movieId'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='movieId', how='inner')

# Reorder columns and cast types to match target schema:
# Target schema: ['movieId': int, 'title': str, 'genres': str, 'userId': float, 'rating': float]

# movieId: int
df_joined['movieId'] = df_joined['movieId'].astype(int)

# title: string (already string)
df_joined['title'] = df_joined['title'].astype(str)

# genres: string (already string)
df_joined['genres'] = df_joined['genres'].astype(str)

# userId: float (source userId is int, convert to float)
df_joined['userId'] = df_joined['userId'].astype(float)

# rating: float (already float)
df_joined['rating'] = df_joined['rating'].astype(float)

# Select and reorder columns as per target schema
target_df = df_joined[['movieId', 'title', 'genres', 'userId', 'rating']]

# Write the result to the target path without the index
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_55/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_55/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_55/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on movieId
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="movieId", how="inner")

# Group by movieId, title, genres and aggregate userId and rating by mean
grouped = joined.groupby(["movieId", "title", "genres"], as_index=False).agg({
    "userId": "mean",
    "rating": "mean"
})

# Ensure column order and types match target schema
grouped = grouped[["movieId", "title", "genres", "userId", "rating"]]
grouped["movieId"] = grouped["movieId"].astype(int)
grouped["title"] = grouped["title"].astype(str)
grouped["genres"] = grouped["genres"].astype(str)
grouped["userId"] = grouped["userId"].astype(float)
grouped["rating"] = grouped["rating"].astype(float)

# Write output
grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_55/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
